STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_033684.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_033684.v · Open raw
module origen_033684(
    input wire clk,
    input wire [31:0] instruction,
    output reg [5:0] op,
    output reg [3:0] opr_alu,
    output reg [4:0] shamt,
    output reg [4:0] rs,
    output reg [4:0] rt,
    output reg [4:0] rd,
    output reg [4:0] wa,
    output reg wa_flag,
    output reg [31:0] imm,
    output reg [31:0] imm_0,
    output reg [25:0] jump_addr,
    output reg stop
);

    reg [3:0] clk_counter;
    reg [5:0] op_reg;
    reg [3:0] opr_alu_reg;
    reg [4:0] wa_reg;
    reg wa_flag_reg;
    reg [31:0] imm_reg, imm_0_reg;
    reg stop_reg;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (clk_counter == 4'b0000) begin
            clk_counter <= clk_counter + 1;
        end else if (clk_counter == 4'b0001) begin
            op_reg <= instruction[31:26];
            rs <= instruction[25:21];
            rt <= instruction[20:16];
            rd <= instruction[15:11];
            shamt <= instruction[10:6];
            jump_addr <= instruction[25:0];

            case (instruction[31:26])
                6'b000000: begin // R-type
                    case (instruction[5:0])
                        6'b100000: opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0000; // ADD
                        6'b100010: opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0001; // SUB
                        6'b100100: opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0010; // AND
                        6'b100101: opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0011; // OR
                        6'b101010: opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0100; // SLT
                        default: opr_alu_reg <= 4'b1111;   // Invalid
                    endcase
                    wa_reg <= instruction[15:11];
                    wa_flag_reg <= 1'b1;
                end
                6'b001000: begin // ADDI
                    opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0000;
                    wa_reg <= instruction[20:16];
                    wa_flag_reg <= 1'b1;
                    imm_reg <= {{16{instruction[15]}}, instruction[15:0]};
                    imm_0_reg <= {16'b0, instruction[15:0]};
                end
                6'b000100: begin // BEQ
                    opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0001;
                    wa_flag_reg <= 1'b0;
                    imm_reg <= {{16{instruction[15]}}, instruction[15:0]};
                end
                6'b000010: begin // J
                    wa_flag_reg <= 1'b0;
                end
                6'b101011: begin // SW
                    opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0000;
                    wa_flag_reg <= 1'b0;
                    imm_reg <= {{16{instruction[15]}}, instruction[15:0]};
                end
                6'b100011: begin // LW
                    opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0000;
                    wa_reg <= instruction[20:16];
                    wa_flag_reg <= 1'b1;
                    imm_reg <= {{16{instruction[15]}}, instruction[15:0]};
                end
                6'b001010: begin // SLTI
                    opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0100;
                    wa_reg <= instruction[20:16];
                    wa_flag_reg <= 1'b1;
                    imm_reg <= {{16{instruction[15]}}, instruction[15:0]};
                    imm_0_reg <= {16'b0, instruction[15:0]};
                end
                6'b000101: begin // BNE
                    opr_alu_reg <= 4'b0001;
                    wa_flag_reg <= 1'b0;
                    imm_reg <= {{16{instruction[15]}}, instruction[15:0]};
                end
                6'b101001: begin // Opcode 41 (Jump and Link)
                    wa_reg <= 5'b11111; // $ra (register 31)
                    wa_flag_reg <= 1'b1;
                end
                6'b111111: begin // Stop condition
                    stop_reg <= 1'b1;
                end
                default: begin
                    opr_alu_reg <= 4'b1111; // Invalid operation
                    wa_flag_reg <= 1'b0;
                end
            endcase

            clk_counter <= clk_counter + 1;
        end else if (clk_counter == 4'b0010) begin
            op <= op_reg;
            opr_alu <= opr_alu_reg;
            wa <= wa_reg;
            wa_flag <= wa_flag_reg;
            imm <= imm_reg;
            imm_0 <= imm_0_reg;
            stop <= stop_reg;

            clk_counter <= 4'b0000;
        end else begin
            clk_counter <= clk_counter + 1;
        end
    end

endmodule
